title: Reports
seo: Etsy shop reports on sales, fees and ads
meta: A plain Etsy report on sales, fees, ad spend and top listings, with clear next steps. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Etsy reports that show what your shop really earns
overview: We download your Etsy stats and statements and turn them into one readable report. You see revenue, fees, ad spend, shipping costs and what is left, along with your top listings, slow listings, traffic sources and conversion rate. Every section has a sentence explaining what it means and what to try next. We use only the data in your own shop, so nothing is estimated from outside sources.

pkgs.blurb: One month of sales, fees and ad spend explained.
Two months compared, with traffic and conversion detail.
A quarter of trends, with a dashboard sheet and a review call.

faq: Shop manager access to view stats and finances, or exported CSV files from your Shop Manager. We read orders, payments and ads data only, and we never need your bank login.
Can you include my materials cost?
Yes, if you send them. Add a cost sheet with materials and packaging per item, and we add true profit per listing. Without it, we report net revenue after Etsy fees and shipping.
Will the report tell me what to change?
Yes, three actions at the end, each tied to a number in the report. We also say where the data is too thin to decide, so you do not change something on a few sales.
Do I get this every month?
This is a one-off report in a fixed package. A monthly report can be quoted separately, using the same layout so you can compare month to month.
